blocks.text: Google DeepMind 取得重大成就，展示了一个 AI 系统能够以数学方式证明软件是安全的，而无需信任 AI 本身。

inlines.text: Google DeepMind 取得重大成就，展示了一个 AI 系统能够以数学方式证明软件是安全的，而无需信任 AI 本身。

blocks.text: 他们只是用 AI 智能体以数学方式证明了 Signal 实际运行的代码能保持消息机密。
Google 的 AI 智能体编写了 650 万行数学证明，证明 Signal 编译后的代码能保持聊天私密。

inlines.text: Google 的 AI 智能体编写了 650 万行数学证明，证明 Signal 编译后的代码能保持聊天私密。

blocks.text: 检查是在处理器实际执行的指令层面进行的。该实验室表示，此前从未有人对任何广泛使用的协议做到这一点。

inlines.text: 检查是在处理器实际执行的指令层面进行的。该实验室表示，此前从未有人对任何广泛使用的协议做到这一点。

blocks.text: 常规测试会尝试许多输入，并希望命中那个坏输入。而证明则表明安全规则在所有情况下都成立，并且 Lean 证明检查器会拒绝 AI 写出的任何错误步骤。
真实缺陷往往在设计被转化为代码时潜入，因此检查处理器层面的代码填补了这一缺口。Rust 编译器也不被信任，因此编译器犯的错误也会被捕获。
这项工作耗时 4 周，而专家团队过去需要数年。由 40 到 80 个 Gemini Carbon 智能体组成的团队编写了约 650 万行 Lean，而人类设定安全目标并审查智能体标记出的 1%。
为了检查该系统不能随便批准任何代码，研究人员将 2 个旧的、已修复的 Signal 缺陷重新放回一个副本中。两次它都生成了机器检查的证明，表明该代码不安全。
更大的转变在于成本：既然 AI 能在数周内产出机器检查的证明，而不是耗时数年的项目，这类证明将成为设备固件、电网软件和其他关键代码的常规检查。
Big achievement by Google DeepMind for showing that an AI system that proves a software is secure mathematically, with no need to trust the AI.

inlines.text: Big achievement by Google DeepMind for showing that an AI system that proves a software is secure mathematically, with no need to trust the AI.

blocks.text: They just used AI agents to mathematically prove that Signal’s real running code keeps messages secret.
Google's AI agents wrote 6.5M lines of math proving Signal’s compiled code keeps chats private.

blocks.text: Normal testing tries many inputs and hopes to hit the bad one. A proof shows the security rules hold in every case, and the Lean proof checker rejects any wrong step the AI writes.

Real bugs often creep in when a design gets turned into code, so checking the processor-level code closes that gap. The Rust compiler isn’t trusted either, so a mistake by the compiler would also get caught.

The work took 4 weeks, where expert teams used to need years. Teams of 40 to 80 Gemini Carbon agents wrote about 6.5M lines of Lean, while humans set the security goals and reviewed the 1% the agents flagged.
To check that the system can’t just approve any code, the researchers put 2 old, already fixed Signal bugs back into a copy. Both times it produced a machine-checked proof that the code was insecure.

The bigger shift is cost, now that AI can produce machine-checked proofs in weeks, rather than years-long projects and become routine checks for device firmware, power grid software and other critical code.
